messages:
anna.finance: Quick decision needed 1: narrowed vendors to ReconcilePro and InvoiceWeave for invoice/usage reconciliation. Key must-haves: per-request line items, cost_center tags, Parquet/NDJSON export to GCS, and clear credit/refund SLA.

derek.sourcing: Do we have sample exports? timezone handling + currency fields matter.

anna.finance: ReconcilePro sent Parquet + NDJSON samples. InvoiceWeave sent daily-aggregated CSV only.

jordan.eng: Aggregated daily is a blocker unless they provide raw event API. We need request_id, model_name, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens.

anna.finance: InvoiceWeave says per-request export is "roadmap Q2"; ReconcilePro supports streaming webhooks + bulk exports.

marta.legal: Need SOC2, DPA, data deletion SLA, and CMK option for exports. InvoiceWeave's DPA lacks region pinning. Flag that.

sophia.billing: Pricing snapshot: ReconcilePro = $0.018/1k tokens + $1,000/mo platform fee. InvoiceWeave = $5k/mo commit up to 200M tokens, onboarding $2k, overage $0.02/1k.

derek.sourcing: I'll request waived onboarding from InvoiceWeave and try to get ReconcilePro to waive platform fee for 12mo commit. Also push for a capped 60-day pilot.

jordan.eng: Engineering checklist:
- realtime webhook with replay
- exports: NDJSON/Parquet/CSV
- BigQuery/GCS connector
- ISO8601 UTC timestamps
- model-level cost splits for multi-model requests
- SCIM/SSO + audit logs
If vendor fails >2 items, escalate.

sophia.billing: Accounting needs daily line items partitioned by date and cost_center mapping. Also monthly reconciliation summary and dispute workflow.

marta.legal: Add contract requirements: 30-day data retrieval window, certified deletion, 72h breach notification, and indemnity language for non-US vendors.

procurement-bot: Ticket created PR-2026-0748 1 (Reconciliation vendor eval). Assigned to @derek.sourcing. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PR-2026-0748

anna.finance: Action items:
- Derek: negotiate pilot cap + onboarding waiver with InvoiceWeave (due Thu)
- Derek: ask ReconcilePro for platform fee waiver with 12mo commit (due Thu)
- Jordan: validate ReconcilePro Parquet schema + webhook replay (due Wed)
- Sophia: model cost scenarios (12mo commit vs pay-as-you-go) (due Tue)
- Marta: request SOC2 + DPA redlines (due Fri)
Update PR-2026-0748 when done.

derek.sourcing: noted. Can finance pre-approve a $12k pilot cap to avoid delays?

sophia.billing: I can approve up to $12k for pilot under manager signoff. Above that needs FP&A signoff.

anna.finance: Ok locking $12k pilot cap. I'll attach anonymized sample logs to the ticket for vendor tests.

jordan.eng: Also need confirmation vendors can split costs when a single request hits multiple models (e.g., rerank + gen). ReconcilePro confirmed; InvoiceWeave unclear. Mark for follow-up.

anna.finance: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after vendor replies. End of thread.
